up: Return all distinct molecules (ChEMBL ID and preferred name) that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5726773.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE cr.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726773')
